fields.recap1: You will not get everything right away there will be confusion and gaps in knowledge but simply walking over the gaps and walking forward is what will enable you to progress and overcome.
fields.recap2: You must put yourself in different mindsets and one way that might be helpful is to put on different "hats". This could be a style hat for making your site look pretty and easy to use or a logical hat for problem solving and  web development.
fields.recap3: Tools and reusable packages fit together because it forms a software supply chain, where tools manage, build, and run the packages that developers write.
fields.recap4: A request flow is the step-by-step path an HTTP request takes from, like a web browser,  to a server and back again. A response flow is the path that data travels when a system receives a request, processes it, and sends the final answer back to the user or application.
fields.purpose: It should help explain some of the difficulties a newcomer should face so they could over come it easier.
